profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000723125. On its own site the company describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, saying it powers AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. It also says its mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies that enable predictive and insightful experiences for end users.

The site's material is aimed largely at engineers and buyers. It offers data sheets, design tools and technical documentation, an online source for placing and tracking orders for memory samples, sales support, and enrollment in Micron's Technology Enablement Program.

Beyond that, the record is sparse. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for the company. Its legal exposure is recorded in Idaho, with a count of 21.
